mainText: Democrat Abdul El-Sayed defeated Republican Mike Rogers in the Michigan Senate race.

titleText: JTF News: Deutsche Welle, CBC News
mainText: Democrats gained control of the House and Senate from Republicans in US midterm elections.
Democrats gained control of the Senate in U.S. midterm elections.
Democrat Josh Turek won the Senate seat in Iowa.
South Carolina elected a Democratic candidate to the U.S. Senate for the first time in approximately 30 years.
